name: desktop-release-check
description: Check the release setup of an Electron or Tauri desktop app before it ships, from its files only: the Electron version against Electron's support policy, webPreferences security settings, Windows signing, macOS hardened runtime and notarization, auto-update over plain http or without a Tauri pubkey, and checked-in certificate or key files, each with the file and line. Never runs a build, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
